text: Visitors have raised concerns about the heavy reliance on AI in the exhibits, with some feeling the experience lacked substantive historical content and was not accessible to taller guests. Several reviews mentioned poor lighting and insufficient signage, which made navigating the library difficult and frustrating. The timed entry system caused confusion, with visitors advising others to book early slots and arrive later to avoid crowds. Food service also received negative comments regarding quality and wait times. Despite these issues, the overall average rating remains relatively high.
